title: Thread encoder capability facts into preflight evidence
summary: Derived EncodingCapabilityFacts from descriptor capability report rows and exposed those facts through settings workspace plus launch preflight read-only evidence.
reason: The encoder breadth plan called for descriptor dump evidence to feed validation-capability consumers before hardware encoder activation. This adds the read-only evidence handoff without changing FFmpeg command generation, encoder selection, or launch blocking behavior.
behavior_before: Settings workspace and launch preflight exposed available/unavailable encoder lists from encoder_capabilities.json, but did not include a validation-ready EncodingCapabilityFacts payload derived from descriptor rows.
behavior_after: Available descriptor rows are converted into bounded video/backend EncodingCapabilityFacts. Settings workspace and /api/launch/preflight include that read-only facts payload in encoder_capability_report detail while preserving non-blocking preflight behavior.
manual_validation: python -m py_compile encoding_capabilities.py settings_policy.py preflight_facade.py - passed
rollback_plan: Remove encoding_capability_facts_from_encoder_rows, drop encoding_capability_facts from settings/preflight report payloads, revert the focused tests and active-doc status updates, then refresh generated summaries.
notes:
Threaded descriptor capability report rows into EncodingCapabilityFacts and launch preflight/settings evidence without changing encoder command behavior.
Refreshed generated summaries for the touched docs, config, preflight, and test files.
No FFmpeg command generation, encoder descriptor activation, filesystem mutation, or launch-blocking behavior changed in this slice.
